title: league_standings advertises Serie B / Serie C but no such data is loaded
evidence: Sources/BrazilianSoccer/Tools.swift:567 tool param says "'Serie A' (default), 'Serie B' or 'Serie C'" and Models.swift:52-53 defines serieB/serieC, but DataStore.matchFiles (DataStore.swift:10-13) loads only Brasileirão(serieA)/Copa do Brasil/Libertadores, so competition='Serie B' returns "No Serie B matches found".
suggestion: Drop the Serie B/C options from the tool schema (and enum) or load Serie B/C data; the advertised filters currently resolve to empty results.
